The structure of composition Cu8Ge4Au4 (reduced formula Cu2GeAu) crystallizes in the cubic space group Fd-3m (No. 216), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. The geometric neighbor graph is a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Cu-centered 8-vertex polyhedra, and corner and face sharing between Au- and Ge-centered polyhedra.
